profile.headline: Retired Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Over 20 years of experience developing world-class software products used by millions of people worldwide.  

Actively searching for my next individual contributor position.

Deeply knowledgable in C and C++.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Designed and implemented telemetry updates for internal conversational AI platform.
* Drove ongoing quality improvements across team based on telemetry reporting.
* Refactored core dictation experiences to support new speech platform.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Investigated and prototyped a voice-driven conversational bot using C#, Bot Framework, and Bing Speech Services.
* Drove end-to-end telemetry across client, speech server, and bot server 
* Used telemetry reports to identify and improve unhelpful bot responses

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Implemented extensions to the core dictation experience for Windows Mobile
* Ported the core dictation experience to HoloLens, Xbox, Mixed Reality, and Desktop
* Implemented telemetry to understand primary failure points and reduced failures by 30%

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Designed a markup language for representing natural language dialog flows for Microsoft Cortana.
* Designed and implemented a visual editor for the markup language above.
* Designed and implemented significant enhancements to the language generation feature for Microsoft Cortana.

positions.title: Senior Software Design Engineer
positions.description:
* Designed and implemented the user-mode portion of Precision Touchpad experiences for Windows 8.1
* Designed and Implemented a prototype of ink-based markup for Internet Explorer and Edge
* Implemented several prototypes for touch-based UI for future versions of Windows.

positions.title: Senior Software Design Engineer
positions.description:
Created touch-based touch selection for Internet Explorer and Windows Web Apps for Windows 8.
Worked with several other teams at Microsoft to produce a consistent text selection experience across editing frameworks.
Also worked on touch targeting algorithms for desktop and modern applications for Windows 8.

positions.title: Software Design Engineer
positions.description:
Developer for voice-driven user interface for Microsoft Windows.  

Created system to dictate and correct text into Text Services Framework-aware applications, including Microsoft Word.

Converted Windows Speech Recognition over to use UI Automation instead of Active Accessibility.

positions.title: Contractor
positions.description: Developer for voice-driven user interface for Microsoft Windows.

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description: Responsible for designing, implementing, and documenting the dictation analysis, core data-driven HTML scraping engine, response generation, text to speech interface, and e-mail agent portions of the Voicebox Interactive Voice Assistant.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
2001:  Development Lead for voice-enabled Personal Information Management Applications on a Pocket PC platform.

Led a team of 5 developers on this project.  Primarily responsible for the architectural and functional specifications, and the primary development contact for the development partner.

2000-2001: Design and implementation of a set of enhancements for the Experience Music Project networking programs.
Responsible for improving the performance of the networking code on the EMP servers.

positions.title: Software Design Engineer
positions.description:
1996-1998: Implemented Java AWT for Microsoft Windows CE 1.0 and 2.0.

1994-1996: Design and implementation of development tools and scripting languages for Interactive Television trials.

1989-1994: Word Program Group
Developed the Word for Macintosh converter in 1990.
Rewrote the Rich Text Format specification in 1991, which was previously disorganized and incomprehensible to people that did not already understand the RTF specification implicitly.  After my reorganization, it was possible for outside developers to actually understand how RTF works.
Technical lead in 1992 for the conversions group; designed and implemented of the WordPerfect 5.x converter for Microsoft Word. This converter imported WordPerfect documents without altering existing formatting, thus allowing Microsoft Word to achieve market domination.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description: Design and implementation of upgrades for flagship spreadsheet product, Ultracalc.

projects.title: Touch Text Selection for Internet Explorer
projects.description: Created the touch-driven text selection experience for Internet Explorer 10 in Windows 8.

projects.title: Touch targeting for Microsoft Windows
projects.description: Create algorithms and implementations to support touch targeting (moving touch points to contact nearby controls) for Windows, Internet Explorer, XAML, and other Microsoft-internal UI frameworks.

publications.title: Speak Up:  Support Dictation With Text Services Framework

patents.title: Multimodal input using scratchpad graphical user interface to edit speech text input with keyboard input
patents.description: A voice typing panel that allows users to dictate text and correct it using keyboard input (arrow keys, etc.) before final entry into an application.
